question: How many hydrogen atoms does a molecule of calcium hydroxide contain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂)** contain** two hydrogen atoms molecule.**
 
• **Calcium hydroxide**, also **called slaked lime, Ca(OH)2, **is **obtained **by the action of **water **on **calcium oxide.**
 
• When **mixed **with **water**, a small proportion of it dissolves, forming a solution known as **limewater**, the rest remaining as a **suspension **called **milk of lime**.
 
• **Calcium hydroxide** is **used **as an** industrial alkali** and as a constituent of mortars, **plasters**, and **cement**.
 
• It is used in the** kraft pape**r process and as a flocculant in **sewage treatment.**
